products.name: Marina jet pump with pressure tank
products.summary: Self-priming jet pump fitted on a horizontal pressure tank, with gauge and flexible hose.
products.description:
A complete booster set: the jet pump sits on a horizontal pressure vessel with a pressure gauge and a flexible braided hose already connected. The tank keeps pressure steady so the pump does not start every time a tap opens.

Pump size, power and flow rate vary by model. Tell us your building, number of floors and water source in chat and we will confirm the right pump before you pay.

specs.Type: Jet pump with horizontal pressure tank

products.name: Horizontal multistage water pump
products.summary: Stainless-steel multistage pump for steady pressure to upper floors and garden lines.
products.description:
A horizontal multistage pump with a stainless-steel body and a compact motor. Multiple impellers give a smooth, higher-pressure flow, suited to boosting supply to upper floors, showers and garden irrigation.

Pump size, power and flow rate vary by model. Tell us your building, number of floors and water source in chat and we will confirm the right pump before you pay.

products.name: Centrifugal pump with brass fittings

products.summary: Large-body centrifugal pump for higher flow.

Pump size, power and flow rate vary by model. Tell us your building, number of floors and water source in chat and we will confirm the right pump before you pay.

products.summary: Small peripheral pump for household water supply and tank filling.
products.description:

products.name: Pedrollo pump with Easy Press controller
products.summary: Peripheral pump supplied with the orange Easy Press controller mounted on it.
products.description:
A Pedrollo peripheral pump with the orange Easy Press controller fitted on the outlet. The controller starts the pump when a tap opens and stops it when the tap closes, and its gauge shows line pressure.

Pump size, power and flow rate vary by model. Tell us your building, number of floors and water source in chat and we will confirm the right pump before you pay.

products.name: Easy Press automatic pump controller
products.summary: Orange Pedrollo controller with pressure gauge, for automatic start and stop.
products.description:
The Easy Press controller turns a manual pump into an automatic one. It starts the pump when a tap opens, stops it when the tap closes, and shows pressure on its built-in gauge.

Fits on the outlet of your pump and works with most single-phase household pumps. Ask us to confirm compatibility with your pump.

products.name: Milano automatic pump control
products.summary: Blue automatic pump controller with power, pump and failure indicator lights.
products.description:
An automatic pump controller with indicator lights for power, pump running and failure, and a restart button. Fitted between the pump and the pipework so the pump runs only when water is needed.

Fits on the outlet of your pump and works with most single-phase household pumps. Ask us to confirm compatibility with your pump.

products.name: Automatic pump control, light blue
products.summary: Light-blue automatic pump controller with status lights and restart button.
products.description:
An automatic pump control unit with status lights for power, pump and failure, and a restart button. Screws directly onto the pump outlet.

Fits on the outlet of your pump and works with most single-phase household pumps. Ask us to confirm compatibility with your pump.

products.name: Pressure control units with gauge
products.summary: Mechanical pressure controllers with gauge, in blue and yellow.
products.description:
Pressure control units with a built-in gauge and a coloured cap, shown here in blue and yellow. They switch the pump on and off according to line pressure.

Fits on the outlet of your pump and works with most single-phase household pumps. Ask us to confirm compatibility with your pump.
